lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Bob, you came home tired
From the Houston heat
Forty years of steel and pipe
And work boots on your feet
You built our days with steady hands
You gave us all your best
Three kids grew up on your hard work
And the love you never let rest

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the years have rolled on by
But your heart still shines the same
And every line around your eyes
Tells the story of your name

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you so
Happy birthday, Bob
Watch that long line float
You worked so hard
You made our home
Happy birthday, Bob
You’re the heart we know
(Bob, Bob)
(We love you so)

[Verse 2]
Now you and Lake Conroe
Share the early dawn
Quiet water, silver tail
And the reel sings on
A cooler on the dock side
A grin beneath your cap
That easy kind of gladness
We all come back to that

[Pre-Chorus]
And when you cast out on the lake
With the sun coming up on high
We hope you feel us close to you
In every flutter by

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you so
Happy birthday, Bob
Watch that long line float
You worked so hard
You made our home
Happy birthday, Bob
You’re the heart we know
(Bob, Bob)
(We love you so)

[Bridge]
Seventy candles, shining
On a cake made bright
For the man who carried us
Through a thousand nights
From Houston steel to Conroe dawn
You never walked alone
You gave us everything you had
And made a house a home

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you so
Happy birthday, Bob
Watch that long line float
You worked so hard
You made our home
Happy birthday, Bob
You’re the heart we know
(Bob, Bob)
(We love you so)

[Outro]
Happy birthday, Bob
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you, Bob
We love you so
title: Bob on Conroe
